display.purpose: Welcome headline; responsive sizes are documented in DESIGN.md.

motion.name: welcome-control
motion.purpose: Welcome button and suggestion color transitions.

motion.name: welcome-scenery
motion.purpose: Static scenery; existing reduced-motion rules also cover frog animations.

components.name: Start the debate
components.description: Question submission with enabled, hover, focus, and disabled states.
components.css: .ds-start{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;width:100%;min-height:48px;padding:12px 16px;border:0;border-radius:9px;background:var(--pond,#0d4f45);color:var(--cream,#fff7dd);font-size:15px;font-weight:800;transition:background-color 160ms ease}.ds-start:hover:not(:disabled){background:#176956}.ds-start:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--pond,#0d4f45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-start:disabled{background:#d8dfd0;color:#4b5c50;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Question field
components.description: Visible label and vertically resizable question input.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-question">What should the frogs argue about?</label><textarea class="ds-field" id="ds-question" placeholder="Should schools have longer recess?"></textarea>
components.css: .ds-label{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;color:var(--pond,#0d4f45);font-size:22px;font-weight:900;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.015em}.ds-field{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:block;box-sizing:border-box;width:100%;min-height:116px;resize:vertical;margin-top:18px;padding:13px;border:1px solid #aca99a;border-radius:9px;background:#fffef9;color:var(--ink,#182320);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;caret-color:var(--pond,#0d4f45)}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#656b60}.ds-field:focus{border-color:var(--pond,#0d4f45);outline:2px solid var(--pond,#0d4f45);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Question suggestion
components.description: Fills the input; pale green marks hover and selection.
components.css: .ds-suggestion{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;width:100%;min-height:44px;padding:9px 0;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid #dce0d3;background:transparent;color:var(--pond,#0d4f45);font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.4;text-align:left;transition:color 160ms ease,background-color 160ms ease}.ds-suggestion:hover,.ds-suggestion[aria-pressed="true"]{background:#edf3e5}.ds-suggestion:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--pond,#0d4f45);outline-offset:3px}.ds-suggestion:disabled{opacity:.6;cursor:wait}

components.name: Parchment panel
components.description: Warm entry surface above the dusk scene.
components.html: <section class="ds-panel">Bring a question and watch the debate unfold.</section>
components.css: .ds-panel{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;padding:25px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--panel,#fffdf2);color:var(--ink,#182320);box-shadow:0 15px 32px rgba(9,25,31,.22)}

components.name: Stats navigation pill
components.description: Existing secondary header link; typography and states expanded from Tailwind.
components.css: .ds-nav{font-family:ui-rounded, "Avenir Next", Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:9999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.7);color:var(--pond,#0d4f45);font-size:12px;line-height:16px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)}.ds-nav:hover{background:white}.ds-nav:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f3cf95;outline-offset:2px}

narrative.overview: Question entry is the entrance to the existing pond theater. Dark teal surroundings, a dusk sky, familiar frogs, and a parchment form connect the welcome and debate views. The operating task is choosing a question and starting a debate, with plain language suitable for a 12-year-old.
keyCharacteristics: Existing green YES frog, pink NO frog, and purple judge SVGs.
Rounded system typography, bold headings, and warm light surfaces.
A usable question form near the top on desktop and phones.
dos: Do reuse TheaterFrog, LilyPad, and PondScenery for continuity with the debate.
Do retain visible focus, labeled fields, and readable submission and error states.
Do keep welcome scenery static and preserve reduced-motion support.
donts: Don't replace the established pond identity or font stack for this refinement.
Don't add generated raster assets when the existing SVG scenery and characters serve the surface.
Don't let decorative content push question entry below a long introduction.
